mapper.sql: id, username, password_hash, name, role, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dbo.sys_user WHERE username=#{username} AND deleted=0
SELECT FROM dbo.sys_user WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
SELECT FROM dbo.sys_user ORDER BY id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dbo.sys_user(username, password_hash, name, role, status) VALUES(#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{role}, ISNULL(#{status}, 1))
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.sys_user SET username=#{username}, name=#{name}, role=#{role}, status=ISNULL(#{status}, status), updated_at=SYSDATETIME() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dbo.sys_user SET password_hash=#{passwordHash}, updated_at=SYSDATETIME() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dbo.sys_user SET deleted=1, updated_at=SYSDATETIME() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.permission_code FROM dbo.sys_user_permission up INNER JOIN dbo.sys_permission p ON up.permission_id = p.id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.permission_code
SELECT id, permission_code, permission_name, module, created_at, updated_at FROM dbo.sys_permission ORDER BY module, permission_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dbo.sys_user_permission(user_id, permission_id) SELECT #{userId}, id FROM dbo.sys_permission WHERE permission_code = #{permissionCode}
